method_notes: Causal entry uses the last confirmed price carried to confirmation plus the declared execution delay.
Strict executable exits require an observed event within exit_grace_seconds of the horizon.
Snapshot returns use the last price at or before the horizon and expose snapshot age; they never use a future event days later.
Failure tags are diagnostics and do not authorize a live trade.
